title: TV journalist is crowned king of Uganda's Tooro Kingdom
contentSnippet: Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma has ascended to the throne after King Oyo died at the age of 34 due to a cancer battle. He previously worked for Ugandan broadcaster UBC as a TV anchor and editor.
